title: LookCamera
description: Data file content/look/camera.json: isometric overview camera, mouse first (B2567): free orbit and pitch with the right or middle button, pan by dragging the ground with the left button (or middle + Shift), wheel zoom towards the mouse cursor, keys that move and turn with eased speed, follow mode (B2 R26). A short click stays a click (select, place a gift). The projection is a data value until Marcel's picture question T1 is answered (proposal: perspective with a narrow field of view). All moves are smooth.

projection.description: perspective (narrow field of view, fixed iso pitch) or orthographic.

fov_deg.description: Vertical field of view for perspective.

pitch_deg.description: Downward tilt of the camera at start (and after reset), within pitch_range_deg.

pitch_deg_per_px.description: Change of the pitch per pixel of vertical orbit dragging (dragging down looks more from above).

zoom_step.description: Share of the distance one zoom step changes.

rotate_deg_per_px.description: Turn (yaw) per pixel of horizontal orbit dragging.

pan_speed_m_s.description: Top key panning speed at the start distance (faster when zoomed out).

key_turn_deg_s.description: Top turning speed of the turn keys (Q/E) in degrees per second.

key_ease_in_s.description: Time constant of the key moves speeding up (seconds; about 63 % of the top speed after this time, no overshoot).

key_ease_out_s.description: Time constant of the key moves slowing down after the key is let go (seconds).

smoothing.description: Share of the remaining way per 1/60 s (0..1, higher is snappier).

bounds_margin_m.description: How far the view may leave the island.

pick_radius_m.description: How close (metres, on the ground) a click must land to a figure to pick it.

click_max_px.description: A press that moves less than this many pixels stays a click (select a figure, place a gift); farther is a camera drag.

click_max_ms.description: A press that moved (within click_max_px) and is held longer than this (milliseconds) is no click; a press that never moved is always a click.

near_m.description: Near clipping distance of the camera.

far_m.description: Far clipping distance of the camera.

PitchRange.description: Pitch limits in degrees: from flat (min) to top-down (max).
